subject: general
question:
Choose the correct meaning of idiom given below:
"A dime a dozen"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Very common**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"A dime a dozen"** means something that is very common and easily available. (बहुत आम और आसानी से उपलब्ध)
 
 
• **Example:** Good ideas are a dime a dozen, but it's execution that really matters.
 
 
• In the context of the given options, "Very common" is the correct meaning of the idiom. (बहुत आम)
 
 
• **Example:** In big cities, coffee shops are a dime a dozen.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Very common**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rare item** (दुर्लभ वस्तु): Something that is uncommon or hard to find.
 
 
• **Example:** Antique coins are considered rare items among collectors.
 
 
 
• **Very costly** (बहुत महंगा): Something that is expensive or high in price.
 
 
• **Example:** Diamonds are very costly and not affordable for everyone.
 
 
 
• **Fake currency** (नकली मुद्रा): Counterfeit money or currency that is not real.
 
 
• **Example:** The police seized a large amount of fake currency during the raid.
 
 

be:T1192,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
